paper.title: The Spandrels of San Marco and the Panglossian Paradigm: A Critique of the Adaptationist Programme
paper.zh_title: 圣马可的拱肩与潘格洛斯范式：对适应主义纲领的批评
paper.author: Stephen Jay Gould; Richard C. Lewontin
paper.citation: Proceedings of the Royal Society of London. Series B, 205(1161), pp. 581–598. DOI: 10.1098/rspb.1979.0086.
paper.description: 教堂建筑的拱肩怎样成为演化思想的比喻？一个特征存在，不等于它是为某个用途进化出来的。
paper.note: 本站双语导读，非原文全文或逐句翻译。重点是检验适应性解释，不是声称自然选择没有作用。
paper.rights: 原论文受版权保护，本页仅提供本站编写的双语导读与来源链接。

blocks.en: The architectural starting point is memorable: spaces produced by a building's structure can later carry elaborate decoration. Their present appearance alone does not explain why those spaces exist.
blocks.zh: 文章的建筑切入点很容易记住：建筑结构产生的空间，后来可以承载精美的装饰。仅凭它们现在的样子，并不能解释这些空间为什么存在。

blocks.en: Gould and Lewontin use this analogy to question explanations that assign an adaptive purpose to every trait. Development, history, and structural constraints also belong in the account.
blocks.zh: 古尔德与莱温廷借此质疑一种解释习惯：为每个性状都安排一个适应用途。发育、历史与结构约束，也应当进入解释。

blocks.en: The challenge is to compare alternatives and ask what evidence discriminates among them. A convincing story about usefulness is a starting hypothesis, rather than its own confirmation.
blocks.zh: 关键是比较不同解释，并问什么证据能够区分它们。一个关于用途的动人故事，可以成为初始假说，却不能自己证明自己。

blocks.en: Reading question: if the proposed function disappeared, could the feature still arise? Keep this question separate from the broader question of whether natural selection operates.
blocks.zh: 阅读时可以追问：如果所提出的功能不存在，这个特征是否仍可能出现？这个问题要与自然选择是否起作用的宏观问题区分开来。
